clips.title: The story
paras: At Greenwarden's Grove in the Wetlands, Rethiel watches the Mosshide numbers rise near the Gate of Algaz. Their fires and trampling threaten the bog, and Rethiel asks travelers to thin their ranks.

Mosshide gnolls lived in the Wetlands for many years without overwhelming the natural order. Now their numbers have surged south toward the pass of Dun Algaz. Their heavy boots and paws crush rare fen plants, while their logging strips groves for campsite fires. If the packs keep growing, the fragile marsh will suffer.

Rethiel the Greenwarden watches the marsh for signs of imbalance. The gnolls' existence is not the trouble; their numbers have grown beyond what the Wetlands can support. Thinning the Mosshide gnolls and mongrels helps preserve the fen, and may earn the approval of its ancient guardian.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Mosshide Gnolls have lived in the Wetlands peacefully for many years, but now grow in numbers. Their feet stamp flat the fen's bushes and flowers, and their foul axes cut too much wood to fuel their fires.
They are no longer in balance with the land. For the Wetlands to survive, the Gnolls must be reduced.
Kill 15 Mosshide Gnolls and 10 Mosshide Mongrels. Hunt them to the south, near the Dwarven gate of Algaz. After you do this, return to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Your task is still at hand, young adventurer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: By reducing the Gnolls' number, you have tended to the health of the Wetlands. Although my faith in your people has been taxed in the past, traveler, it may yet be restored.
